backup_stale.message: An existing database backup is unverified, overdue or explicitly degraded.
next_operations: brine backup status app --database db --target NAME

caddy_admin_exposed.message: Caddy administration is not restricted to loopback.

catch_all_site.message: A hostless Caddy site conflicts with routed deployments.

cgroup_unsupported.message: The target does not use cgroup v2.

control_store_unhealthy.message: The isolated control store failed its SQLite structural check.

control_store_upgrade_required.message: The control store requires a schema upgrade.

disk_below_reserve.message: Free disk space is below the protected policy reserve.

domain_elsewhere.message: A policy domain resolves to another host.

domain_unresolved.message: A policy domain has no host DNS A or AAAA answer.

os_unsupported.message: The target requires Debian 13 on amd64 or arm64.

policy_denies_deploy.message: The protected policy allows no deployment registries or domains.

policy_invalid.message: The protected operator policy is invalid.

proxy_conflict.message: An unrelated listener occupies HTTP or HTTPS ingress.

registry_unreachable.message: A policy registry did not answer anonymous HTTPS /v2/ with 200 or 401.

rootless_helper_missing.message: Rootless uidmap helpers are missing or not setuid executables.

runtime_version_mismatch.message: A required runtime is absent or outside the D2 reference versions.

tls_untrusted.message: A committed route lacks a reachable, hostname-verified local TLS endpoint.

user_session_missing.message: A required runner session prerequisite is missing.
